name: skill-router
description: Automatically searches installed Codex skills for every user prompt and injects the strongest candidates into context.

interface.shortDescription: Automatically find the right installed Codex skills.
interface.longDescription: Runs a local, dependency-free metadata search before each substantive prompt, suggests up to five relevant skills, and tells Codex to read selected SKILL.md files before acting.
defaultPrompt: Find the best installed skill for this request.
Show which skills match my task and why.
